name: ctm-voiceai-mcp
description: MCP server that pulls CTM call transcripts and VoiceAI agent instructions so your assistant can review them and render a prompt-update HTML report, with OAuth2 login. No LLM API or key.
author: Jason Smith <jason.smith@ctm.com>

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/auth.mjs && node test/sanitize.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/render.mjs && node --test test/hosted.mjs test/postgres.mjs
scripts.test:hosted: npm run build && node --test test/hosted.mjs test/postgres.mjs
